def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    vals=[v for row in g for v in row if v]
    color=2 if 2 in vals else max(set(vals))
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==color]
    rs=[c[0] for c in cells]; cs=[c[1] for c in cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    noise=set(vals)-{color}
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i in range(r0,r1+1):
        left=not any(g[i][j] in noise for j in range(0,c0))
        right=not any(g[i][j] in noise for j in range(c1+1,W))
        if left:  out[i][:c0]=[color]*c0
        if right: out[i][c1+1:]=[color]*(W-c1-1)
    for j in range(c0,c1+1):
        up=not any(g[i][j] in noise for i in range(0,r0))
        dn=not any(g[i][j] in noise for i in range(r1+1,H))
        if up:  [out[i].__setitem__(j,color) for i in range(r0)]
        if dn:  [out[i].__setitem__(j,color) for i in range(r1+1,H)]
    return out
